description: Replace the drawing with a previously checkpointed state (clear + reload). Without a label, the MOST RECENT checkpoint is restored. All ids from after the checkpoint are stale afterwards — re-read them (tree/find) before further operations.

drawing.description: The drawing this call works on. "new" opens a new, empty drawing, and the answer names its id; from then on pass that id (e.g. "d-k3v9q2xa") in every call of this conversation about that model. A drawing belongs to the conversation that opened it: no other conversation can see or change it.

label.description: Checkpoint name. Default: the most recently created one.

name: restore
title: Restore checkpoint
